questions.prompt: A chain extracts an invoice amount and then drafts a payment approval. The extraction misreads the amount. What prevents disaster?

options.text: A validation gate after extraction (type, range, cross-check) before the approval step
Running the chain twice as fast
Using more emoji in the prompts

questions.explanation: Checks between steps stop error propagation. Validate costly fields early and add human approval above a threshold.

questions.prompt: Which are benefits of prompt chaining? Select all that apply.

options.text: Code can enforce rules between steps
It always costs less than a single prompt

questions.explanation: Chains add focus, inspectability, and control, but every link is another call, so they usually cost more.

questions.prompt: Decomposing a problem into simpler subproblems and solving them in order is called least-to-____ prompting.
questions.explanation: Least-to-most prompting (Zhou et al., 2022) generalizes to problems harder than the examples, reaching at least 99% on SCAN versus 16% for chain-of-thought.

questions.prompt: When is a single prompt with built-in thinking usually enough instead of a chain?

options.text: When you need human approval between steps
When the task is mainly reasoning and you only need the final answer
When each step must use a different model
When regulators require an audit log of each step

questions.explanation: Chains earn their cost when you need checkpoints. For pure reasoning with only a final answer, a single reasoning prompt is often enough.

questions.prompt: Match each chain shape to its description.

pairs.right: Each step uses the previous step's output
Classify first, then send to a specialized prompt
Repeat until a check passes, with a round limit

questions.explanation: These shapes cover most real-world LLM pipelines.

questions.prompt: Order the steps of the complaint-handling chain from the lesson.

items.text: Write the reply explaining the decision
Extract facts from the email as JSON
Decide the resolution allowed by policy
Stop and ask the customer if the order ID is missing

questions.explanation: Extract, gate on missing information, decide within policy (enforced by code), then write the reply.
